additional_info.subject: Notes to RC
additional_info.body:
RC was on site today (18/3/2025) before our call today without any prior information.
RC tried updating the charger directly from FW V3.2.8 to FW V6.1.3 so I have informed him to remove the USB and Charger is healthy without any active error flags.
RC is now downloading the FW V4.0.11 then we will flash the FW V4.0.11→ FW V 5.0.23→ FW V 6.1.3

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0413197-DC/Si-D/HU-[Y2/S9 313897079/001] software update issue CRM:02679000004
additional_info.body:
Dear Norbert Szilagyi,
I hope this message finds you well.
As per our discussion during the MS Teams call, I would like to confirm that we have successfully updated the charger firmware from FW V3.2.8 → FW V4.0.11 → FW V5.0.23 → FW V6.1.3. Additionally, we conducted charging tests after each firmware update, and I am pleased to report that all sessions were successful.
In line with your request, I have configured the HU language as the primary language, with English and German set as the second and third priorities, respectively.
As agreed upon during our conversation, I am now closing this ticket.
Please feel free to reach out if you require any further assistance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
